title: Number of Islands
problem: Given an m x n 2D binary grid grid which represents a map of '1's (land) and '0's (water), return the number of islands.
constraints:
m == grid.length, n == grid[i].length
1 <= m, n <= 300
grid[i][j] is '0' or '1'.
hints: Use DFS or BFS. When a '1' is found, increment island count and mark all connected land cells as visited (e.g. '0').
